review: The hymn is the invitation to the weary: 1:1–4 is Isa 1:4 with Matt 9:12, 2:1–4 is Isa 55:7 with Ps 34:4, 3:1–4 is Matt 11:28 (quoted) with Isa 53:4, 4:1–4 is Isa 63:1 with Eph 2:4, 5:1–4 is Luke 13:24–25 with Rom 10:3, and 6:1–4 is Matt 11:28 with Heb 4:16.

2:3 keeps the print's split word across the line-break (الْـ / ـسُّبْحَ), and the corpus records stanza 2 as three lines with the praise-phrase on the third; the payload mirrors the break by ending on וְהָבִיאוּ and completing with the praise.
3:3–4 are the quoted word of Christ; the Hebrew uses the colon after אָמַר on 3:3 and lets the last line be the promise, following the glossary convention instead of quotation marks.
